verifications.claim: NASA launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT.' 'Kennedy Space Center in Florida'; R2: 'blasted off ... at 6:35 p.m. Eastern time.' 'Kennedy Space Center in Florida'; R3: 'lifted off from Kennedy Space Center’s Launch Complex 39B in Florida at 6:35 p.m. EDT'; R6: 'lifted off from Launch Pad 39B at the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida at 6:35 p.m. EDT'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact date, time, and location.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first crewed lunar flyby in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first piloted moonshot since the end of the Apollo program 53 years ago'; R2: 'first time in more than 50 years'; R6: 'first crewed lunar flyby in more than 50 years'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state it is the first crewed mission to the Moon since Apollo, over 50 years.
